name: aws_redshift_cluster
description: Petabyte-scale data warehouse for analytics with columnar storage and massively parallel processing

cluster_identifier.name: cluster_identifier
cluster_identifier.description: Unique identifier for the cluster (forces new resource)

node_type.name: node_type
node_type.description: Node type for the Redshift cluster

master_username.name: master_username
master_username.description: Username for the master DB user (required unless restoring from snapshot)

master_password.name: master_password
master_password.description: Password for the master DB user (sensitive, required unless managing via Secrets Manager)

manage_master_password.name: manage_master_password
manage_master_password.description: Allow Redshift to manage the master password in Secrets Manager

database_name.name: database_name
database_name.description: Name of the first database to create

number_of_nodes.name: number_of_nodes
number_of_nodes.description: Number of compute nodes (required for multi-node cluster type)

allow_version_upgrade.name: allow_version_upgrade
allow_version_upgrade.description: Allow automatic major version upgrades during maintenance

cluster_subnet_group_name.name: cluster_subnet_group_name
cluster_subnet_group_name.description: Name of the subnet group for the cluster

vpc_security_group_ids.name: vpc_security_group_ids
vpc_security_group_ids.description: VPC security group IDs to associate with the cluster

publicly_accessible.name: publicly_accessible
publicly_accessible.description: Whether the cluster is publicly accessible

port.name: port
port.description: Port on which the cluster accepts connections

enhanced_vpc_routing.name: enhanced_vpc_routing
enhanced_vpc_routing.description: Enable enhanced VPC routing (forces COPY and UNLOAD traffic through VPC)

kms_key_id.name: kms_key_id
kms_key_id.description: ARN of the KMS key for encryption (requires encrypted=true)

iam_roles.name: iam_roles
iam_roles.description: IAM role ARNs for the cluster to access other AWS services

cluster_parameter_group_name.name: cluster_parameter_group_name
cluster_parameter_group_name.description: Name of the parameter group to associate

automated_snapshot_retention_period.name: automated_snapshot_retention_period
automated_snapshot_retention_period.description: Days to retain automated snapshots (0-35, 0 disables)

skip_final_snapshot.name: skip_final_snapshot
skip_final_snapshot.description: Skip final snapshot before cluster deletion

final_snapshot_identifier.name: final_snapshot_identifier
final_snapshot_identifier.description: Name of the final snapshot when deleting the cluster

snapshot_identifier.name: snapshot_identifier
snapshot_identifier.description: Snapshot ID to restore the cluster from (forces new resource)

elastic_ip.name: elastic_ip
elastic_ip.description: Elastic IP address for the cluster (for single-node clusters in VPC)

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the cluster
